title: Trader Diary: BTC at $78K & My 5x Leverage Fantasies
content:
👀 3 AM: Spot the green candle, heart races.
💥 3:01 AM: Open 5x long, “to the moon!”
📉 3:05 AM: Spot the dip, panic‑sell, “I’m a genius, I timed it!”
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before the coffee kicks in – leverage loves your regret.
question: Who else opened a 5x position at 78K and instantly regretted it? Drop your war stories 👇
